results.title: Berlin - The Last Battle
results.overview: April 1945, amidst the Battle of Berlin, the final days of World War II begin. Young German soldiers fight desperately in the city's ruins. Between bombs, battles, and the stalemate, they question why they must continue fighting. This historical short film depicts the emotional and psychological collapse of a failing regime—intense, powerful, and relentlessly realistic.

results.title: Tacchino
results.overview: In a bar, Sofia and Filippo—once in love, now strangers only on the surface—meet again for a drink that turns into a confession. Between irony and melancholy, the two retrace the past and the failures that have marked them, discovering how difficult it is to live with loneliness and with their own limitations. In the play of banter, memories, and still-open wounds, a subtle affection resurfaces—made of regrets and an intimacy that has survived time—leaving suspended the question of what remains when love ends but does not completely fade away.

results.title: Souvenir
results.overview: While stuck on a family vacation, a young, closeted teen, Keira, must confront the unnerving hold her girlfriend has over her after she takes unwarranted photos of her during sex.

results.title: Hayya 3: Gaza
results.overview: Abdullah Gaza or usually called Gaza is an orphan boy. His father, a humanitarian volunteer, died after returning from Palestine. Since his father's death, Gaza has been placed in an orphanage managed by Ustazah Dewi and his sister Rafah Shafira. There, Gaza met Hayya, a little girl from Palestine who had lived for four years and was trying to find peace in this country. The genocide in Palestine prevented Hayya from returning to his homeland. At the orphanage, Gaza and Hayya's relationship gradually became close. For Hayya, the presence of Gaza is like a cure for longing, considering that its name is similar to the land of his birth. Their lives became cheerful again, complementing each other, until a bad incident came back and threatened their lives.

results.title: Waterwick
results.overview: An obsessed journalism student's investigation of a former psychiatric institution leads him into the most repressed depths of his own haunted psyche.

results.title: Morph
results.overview: A group of young adults plan a staycation for their friend who recently lost a parent. At their most vulnerable, personified fears shape-shift to pick them off one by one. Face them, but with which face?

results.title: It's still early
results.overview: The film follows Nassrallah and Kheira, a young married couple who quickly realize that they are incompatible and decide to divorce. However, their families oppose the separation, and things become even more complicated when a judge refuses to grant an immediate divorce.  Instead, the judge orders the couple to continue living together for one month in an attempt to save their marriage. Forced to share the same home despite their conflicts, they go through a series of humorous and unexpected situations that gradually make them reconsider their relationship.

results.title: Cantar y coser
results.overview: In the village of Beniforquet, a young girl is haunted by the Mediterranean sun when she goes for a walk through an orange grove.

results.title: I’ll Find You
results.overview: A psychiatrist, driven to the edge by physical abuse, abandons her training and seeks vengeance through a chilling act of murder.

results.title: Kombucha
results.overview: Trapped in a fluorescent-lit cubicle farm, an aspiring musician thinks the free break room kombucha is a perk - until it begins to change him. What starts with suspicious smiles and team-building ends in a bile-drenched metamorphosis.

results.title: The World's Dumbest Record
results.overview: The movie follows musicians led by Tymon Tymański, navigating the absurd reality of post-transformation Poland, full of kitsch and contradictions. In 1997, as the band Kury, they recorded the legendary album P.O.L.O.V.I.R.U.S., a satirical take on 90s Poland—capitalism, show business, and a disco polo-dominated scene. Balancing parody and social commentary, this musical experiment became a defining postcard of the era. Twenty-five years later, its relevance endures as the band reunites to play it live, once again confronting the question: what are success and creative freedom?

results.title: Fever
results.overview: Constantly interrupted by the ringing of a telephone, a man is desperate to poke his eye out. Can he succeed?

results.title: Mastiii 4
results.overview: Three frustrated husbands seek freedom from their dull marriages. A wild idea promises escape and excitement. But what follows is anything but expected.

results.title: IDOLiSH7 First BEAT! Movie Edition Part 1
results.original_title: アイドリッシュセブン First BEAT! 劇場総集編 前編
results.overview: Seven young idols clash over dreams but find harmony through music in their explosive debut.

results.title: Mom Minding the Mosque
results.overview: During her 28 years in Brazil, Bu Ipah has never stopped working. Initially arriving as a housewife with her migrant worker husband, she has spent the last 21 years as a mosque caretaker. During Ramadan, she is especially busy with food orders and iftar events. Despite her many duties, she cares for her youngest child, Totó, while balancing her roles as a mother, liaison to the ummah, and committee member for mosque social programs.

results.title: Naked Ambition
results.overview: Bunny Yeager, once heralded as the world's prettiest photographer, had a huge influence in 20th-century pop culture though few people know her name. Whether by popularizing the bikini, helping discover Bettie Page, shaping the image of Playboy or inventing the selfie, Bunny was a trailblazer whose work bucked against conservative 1950s America and helped pave the way for the feminist movement and the sexual revolution. Yet the very changes she helped usher in would soon render her a forgotten relic...till now.

results.title: Plüss – one awakens to live, another to die for
results.original_title: Plüss – einer erwacht um zu leben, ein anderer um zu sterben
results.overview: Loosely based on Jörg Steiner's «DER KOLLEGE» tells the story of the unemployed MAX PLÜSS. He moved to Biel more than 45 years ago. Today, Plüss learns that he has been «taxed out» and has to apply for social welfare. This surprises him, but does not depress him – despite the winter, cold and high fog.

results.title: Bloody Trophy
results.overview: A shocking investigation into the illegal rhino trade and the international crime syndicates pushing an endangered species toward extinction.

results.title: Ballerina Assassin
results.overview: After a devastating betrayal wipes out her entire spy network, an elite female assassin embarks on a relentless mission to dismantle the syndicate responsible.

results.title: Carcassonne-Acapulco
results.overview: As flight 7836 reaches cruising speed above the Atlantic Ocean, the pilot, co-pilot and flight attendant are startled by an unexpected knock at the door! Should they open the door, or not?
